title: Speeds and a bonus
summary: A menu to choose your speed, and a bonus heart that falls.
done: You saw a menu on another screen, a speed variable and a bonus.

hello.text: In level 4, a **Menu** screen to choose the speed, and bonus hearts.

menu.text: Pick the **Menu** screen: each button sets the **speed** variable, then opens the game. Then come back to **Game**.

speed.text: The ball takes the speed chosen in the menu, instead of 260.

gift.text: The **Gift** timer drops a bonus heart every 6 seconds.

catch.text: Catch it with the paddle: one more life!

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Wait for the heart: [create a clone of Bonus] lights up.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Stop slow motion to play at normal speed.

easy.hint: It is on the Menu screen.

often.hint: It is the interval of Gift, in “new game”.

grow.text: The bonus also makes the paddle wider.
grow.hint: Set the width of Paddle to 130 when the bonus is caught.
